tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in CuizIN player's profile: username, display name, and current gem/points balance.

tools.name: get_my_quiz_stats
tools.title: Get my quiz stats
tools.description: Summarize the signed-in player's quiz performance: total questions attempted, correct answers, accuracy, and points earned. Optionally limit to a recent window of days.

days.description: Only count answers from the last N days. Omit for all-time stats.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List quiz categories
tools.description: List the available CuizIN quiz categories with the number of questions in each.

tools.name: get_quiz_questions
tools.title: Get quiz questions
tools.description: Fetch CuizIN quiz questions with their answer options. Correct answers are never returned. Optionally filter by category and difficulty.

difficulty.description: Filter by difficulty, e.g. easy, medium, hard.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get monthly leaderboard
tools.description: Get the CuizIN monthly points leaderboard. Defaults to the current month; pass a month like '2026-07'.

month.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the current month.

limit.description: Number of top players to return (default 20).
